data.objective: Cancel an owned in-review blocking application from the additional-application conflict dialog into the permanent read-only CANCELLED state after workflow termination, without changing normal withdrawal semantics.

requirements.statement: The conflict dialog must show cancel only for an owned IN_REVIEW blocker when the user has release:application:withdraw permission.
acceptance: The action is absent for other owners and non-IN_REVIEW states
The action label is cancel rather than withdraw
counterexample: Another user's blocker exposes cancel
A withdrawn or cancelled blocker exposes cancel

requirements.statement: Conflict cancellation must use a distinct server command with tenant, owner, permission, state, row-version, round, and reason validation.
acceptance: The conflict dialog does not call the normal withdraw endpoint
Invalid ownership, state, version, round, or reason is rejected
counterexample: The existing withdraw endpoint receives conflict cancellation

requirements.statement: The application must become CANCELLED only after its workflow termination event is consumed from a CANCEL_REQUESTED round.
acceptance: The command changes the round from IN_REVIEW to CANCEL_REQUESTED
TERMINATED maps CANCEL_REQUESTED to application CANCELLED and round TERMINATED
No active approval task remains after CANCELLED
requirements.source: User-confirmed final state and workflow consistency design
counterexample: The application is CANCELLED before workflow termination
A CANCELLED application still has an actionable approval task

requirements.statement: Normal list withdrawal must remain WITHDRAW_REQUESTED to WITHDRAWN and retain edit and resubmit behavior.
acceptance: The normal withdraw endpoint and UI remain available
A normal terminated withdrawal ends in WITHDRAWN
WITHDRAWN remains editable and resubmittable
counterexample: Normal withdrawal ends in CANCELLED
WITHDRAWN becomes read-only

requirements.statement: Continue must remain disabled while any blocker is IN_REVIEW or its conflict cancellation is pending.
acceptance: The action displays a cancel-processing state
Two-second polling keeps continue disabled until blockers leave IN_REVIEW
requirements.source: Existing conflict gate plus confirmed cancellation semantics
counterexample: A new application proceeds while old workflow termination is pending

requirements.statement: CANCELLED applications must be permanently read-only in UI and server mutation paths.
acceptance: No edit or resubmit control is available
Update, save, submit, resubmit, attachment add, and attachment delete attempts are rejected server-side
counterexample: A cancelled application can be edited, saved, resubmitted, or have attachments changed

requirements.statement: A synchronous workflow termination failure must not leave the application prematurely CANCELLED.
acceptance: The cancel command fails visibly
Transactional state and event writes roll back
The dialog remains blocked and can retry after refresh
counterexample: Termination fails but the business application is already CANCELLED

invariants: CANCELLED never coexists with an actionable workflow task for the application
The application remains IN_REVIEW until workflow termination is confirmed
Normal withdrawal continues to end in WITHDRAWN
Tenant isolation, ownership checks, permissions, and optimistic locking remain enforced
constraints: Reuse the existing workflow termination gateway and lifecycle dispatch
Do not add a database migration or a new permission key
Poll only while the conflict dialog is open
Protect unrelated dirty changes on local rokey
non_goals: Change normal list withdrawal, cancellation, or resubmission
Cancel another user's application
Change conflict matching or additional-application classification
Backfill existing WITHDRAWN records to CANCELLED

assumptions.text: The workflow termination gateway throws on synchronous failure so the transaction can roll back.
assumptions.falsifier: The gateway returns failure without throwing

assumptions.text: Termination lifecycle events identify the current release round.
assumptions.falsifier: A termination event cannot be matched to tenant, application, and round

decisions.decision: Use a distinct conflict-cancel endpoint and CANCEL_REQUESTED round intent.
decisions.reason: Separate permanent cancellation from recoverable normal withdrawal.

decisions.decision: Finalize CANCELLED only from the workflow TERMINATED event.
decisions.reason: Prevent a cancelled business record from retaining an active approval task.

decisions.decision: Reuse release:application:withdraw authority for the owned in-review conflict shortcut.
decisions.reason: Preserve current eligibility and avoid permission migration.
decisions.source: Current product behavior and approved scope

decisions.decision: Leave normal withdrawal mapped to WITHDRAWN.

design.objective: Cancel an owned in-review blocking application from the additional-application conflict dialog into the permanent read-only CANCELLED state after workflow termination, without changing normal withdrawal semantics.
users: Release applicants resolving their own in-review blocker while creating or saving an additional application

requirements.statement: The conflict dialog must show cancel only for an owned IN_REVIEW blocker when the user has release:application:withdraw permission.
acceptance: The action is absent for other owners and non-IN_REVIEW states
The action label is cancel rather than withdraw
counterexample: Another user's blocker exposes cancel
A withdrawn or cancelled blocker exposes cancel

requirements.statement: Conflict cancellation must use a distinct server command with tenant, owner, permission, state, row-version, round, and reason validation.
acceptance: The conflict dialog does not call the normal withdraw endpoint
Invalid ownership, state, version, round, or reason is rejected
counterexample: The existing withdraw endpoint receives conflict cancellation

requirements.statement: The application must become CANCELLED only after its workflow termination event is consumed from a CANCEL_REQUESTED round.
acceptance: The command changes the round from IN_REVIEW to CANCEL_REQUESTED
TERMINATED maps CANCEL_REQUESTED to application CANCELLED and round TERMINATED
No active approval task remains after CANCELLED
requirements.source: User-confirmed final state and workflow consistency design
counterexample: The application is CANCELLED before workflow termination
A CANCELLED application still has an actionable approval task

requirements.statement: Normal list withdrawal must remain WITHDRAW_REQUESTED to WITHDRAWN and retain edit and resubmit behavior.
acceptance: The normal withdraw endpoint and UI remain available
A normal terminated withdrawal ends in WITHDRAWN
WITHDRAWN remains editable and resubmittable
counterexample: Normal withdrawal ends in CANCELLED
WITHDRAWN becomes read-only

requirements.statement: Continue must remain disabled while any blocker is IN_REVIEW or its conflict cancellation is pending.
acceptance: The action displays a cancel-processing state
Two-second polling keeps continue disabled until blockers leave IN_REVIEW
requirements.source: Existing conflict gate plus confirmed cancellation semantics
counterexample: A new application proceeds while old workflow termination is pending

requirements.statement: CANCELLED applications must be permanently read-only in UI and server mutation paths.
acceptance: No edit or resubmit control is available
Update, save, submit, resubmit, attachment add, and attachment delete attempts are rejected server-side
counterexample: A cancelled application can be edited, saved, resubmitted, or have attachments changed

requirements.statement: A synchronous workflow termination failure must not leave the application prematurely CANCELLED.
acceptance: The cancel command fails visibly
Transactional state and event writes roll back
The dialog remains blocked and can retry after refresh
counterexample: Termination fails but the business application is already CANCELLED

invariants: CANCELLED never coexists with an actionable workflow task for the application
The application remains IN_REVIEW until workflow termination is confirmed
Normal withdrawal continues to end in WITHDRAWN
Tenant isolation, ownership checks, permissions, and optimistic locking remain enforced
constraints: Reuse the existing workflow termination gateway and lifecycle dispatch
Do not add a database migration or a new permission key
Poll only while the conflict dialog is open
Protect unrelated dirty changes on local rokey
non_goals: Change normal list withdrawal, cancellation, or resubmission
Cancel another user's application
Change conflict matching or additional-application classification
Backfill existing WITHDRAWN records to CANCELLED

selected_approach.name: Distinct cancel intent with lifecycle finalization
selected_approach.reason: It keeps workflow and business state consistent while preserving normal withdrawal semantics.

alternatives.name: Immediately set CANCELLED then terminate
alternatives.rejected_because: Termination failure can leave a cancelled application with an active approval task.

alternatives.name: Withdraw then invoke normal cancel
alternatives.rejected_because: It creates a transient editable WITHDRAWN state and an extra row-version race.
